schemes_and_rights.name: Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act 2016
schemes_and_rights.overview: India's landmark rights-based statute covering 21 recognized disabilities, aligned with the UNCRPD.
key_provisions: Mandatory 4% reservation in government jobs for benchmark disabilities.
5% reservation in government and aided higher education institutions.
Strict penalties and fines for discrimination or non-compliance with universal design standards.
Mandatory physical and digital accessibility in public transport, railway stations, airports, and government websites.
February 2026 notification: Mandatory accessibility guidelines for OTT streaming platforms (audio descriptions for blind, closed captions/ISL for deaf).

schemes_and_rights.name: ADIP Scheme (Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances)
schemes_and_rights.implementing_agency: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / ALIMCO
schemes_and_rights.eligibility: Indian citizens with 40% benchmark disability. Monthly income below ₹15,000 receives 100% free aids; monthly income ₹15,001 - ₹20,000 receives 50% subsidy.
covered_devices: Smart white canes with ultrasonic obstacle sensors (SmartCane).
Braille kits, slates, styluses, and refreshable Braille readers (Orbit Reader 20 / Hexis).
Digital behind-the-ear (BTE) hearing aids for kids and adults.
Full funding for pediatric cochlear implant surgeries (up to ₹6,00,000 per child under age 5).

schemes_and_rights.name: UDID Card (Unique Disability ID / Swavlamban Card)
schemes_and_rights.overview: Single universal electronic card verifying disability percentage across all states in India without needing multiple medical certificates.
benefits: Concessional travel in Indian Railways (up to 75% off) and State Road Transport buses.
Direct benefit transfers (DBT) for disability pensions.
Expedited processing for education scholarships and assistive device camps.

schemes_and_rights.name: Sugamya Bharat Abhiyan (Accessible India Campaign)
focus: Built environment accessibility: Retrofitting ramps, tactile paving (guiding & warning tiles), braille signage in 1,000+ railway stations and government collectorates.
Transportation: Lower-floor buses and auditory announcements in metro trains.
Information & Communication: GIGW compliance (Guidelines for Indian Government Websites) ensuring screen-reader accessibility.

schemes_and_rights.name: ISLRTC & NCERT Educational Channel 31
schemes_and_rights.overview: Standardized Indian Sign Language (ISL) repository exceeding 3,000 signs, providing video textbooks for primary and secondary school grades.
